Ashem.title: Ashem
Ashem.name: [color=#8080f0]Ashem[/color]
Ashem.brief: 纪律与宇宙圣洁之神。被众神沙漠的流浪者奉为神圣审判者。奖赏正确的仪式流程
Ashem.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，并造成星界伤害
Ashem.prayer:
O [color=#8080f0]Ashem[/color],

of wisdom's many paths,

I am subject to myself,

preserve my life!
Ashem.description:
你信奉 [color=#8080f0]Ashem[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，并造成星界伤害[/color]

Humbaba.title: Humbaba
Humbaba.name: [color=#a03030]Humbaba[/color]
Humbaba.brief: 生于荒野的战争与流血之神。憎恶文明。奖赏怒意的增幅
Humbaba.description_start: 祈祷赋予血怒，造成鲜血伤害并提供治疗
Humbaba.prayer:
O [color=#a03030]Humbaba[/color],

of the eight circles of fear,

whose eyes are my blood,

who dances in the fire-cloud,

destroyer of peace,

I invoke thee!
Humbaba.description:
你信奉 [color=#a03030]Humbaba[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷赋予血怒，造成鲜血伤害并提供治疗[/color]

Ninhurs.title: Ninhurs
Ninhurs.name: [color=#20af20]Ninhurs[/color]
Ninhurs.brief: 生长与腐朽女神。绿之母充满活力的后裔。奖赏在神圣草地上献祭敌人
Ninhurs.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，铺展神圣草地，造成毒素伤害并召唤神圣巨蛇
Ninhurs.prayer:
O [color=#20af20]Ninhurs[/color],

of the vine's blue flower,

of life's continuous eruption,

of stem and bursted rock,

whose temple is grass,

I kneel to thee!
Ninhurs.description:
你信奉 [color=#20af20]Ninhurs[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，铺展神圣草地，造成毒素伤害并召唤神圣巨蛇[/color]

Mehtar.title: Mehtar
Mehtar.name: [color=#60b0ff]Mehtar[/color]
Mehtar.brief: 寒冰与幻象女神。据说居于世界边缘的高地冰川。奖赏沉入她纯净梦境的人
Mehtar.description_start: 祈祷赋予梦境，并造成寒冰/灵能伤害
Mehtar.prayer:
O [color=#60b0ff]Mehtar[/color],

of the unmoving illusion,

who carries the mind,

on blue feathers...

bless this sleep!
Mehtar.description:
你信奉 [color=#60b0ff]Mehtar[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷赋予梦境，并造成寒冰/灵能伤害[/color]

Dumuzi.title: Dumuzi
Dumuzi.name: [color=#d09000]Dumuzi[/color]
Dumuzi.brief: 黄金陵墓之神。Eris 被杀的配偶。奖赏守护神圣随从与积累护甲
Dumuzi.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，并基于护甲造成死亡/火焰伤害
Dumuzi.prayer:
O [color=#d09000]Dumuzi[/color],

of the glittering mound,

no treasure escapes you,

your silent army,

with limbs of gold,

accept this offering!
Dumuzi.description:
你信奉 [color=#d09000]Dumuzi[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，并基于护甲造成死亡/火焰伤害[/color]

Hadad.title: Hadad
Hadad.name: [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color]
Hadad.brief: 野火与风暴之神。主持了最初的退水。偏爱纯粹战斗之舞的践行者
Hadad.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，并造成闪电/火焰伤害
Hadad.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Hadad.description:
你信奉 [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，并造成闪电/火焰伤害[/color]

Eresh.title: Eresh
Eresh.name: [color=#a0a000]Eresh[/color]
Eresh.brief: 生命饥渴与悲惨亡者女神。在其神圣母亲的尸身中悲恸统治。因盟友死亡与收集神器而欢欣
Eresh.description_start: 祈祷召唤蹒跚死者与可怖的 Eresh 之口
Eresh.prayer:
O [color=#a0a000]Eresh[/color],

of the consuming grave,

whose army slouches from the mire,

whose womb is decay itself,

of the breathless multitude,

of the muttering annihilation,

comfort me!
Eresh.description:
你信奉 [color=#a0a000]Eresh[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷召唤蹒跚死者与可怖的 Eresh 之口[/color]

Dorok.title: Dorok
Dorok.name: [color=#cf6f40]Dorok[/color]
Dorok.brief: 坚忍决意与荣誉战斗之神。居于 Achra 荒野中的无名山内。奖赏受伤与坚持
Dorok.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，清除效果，造成钝击伤害并发动额外攻击
Dorok.prayer:
O [color=#cf6f40]Dorok[/color],

unmoving visage,

you do not listen,

I do not care,

strengthen me,

if you wish...
Dorok.description:
你信奉 [color=#cf6f40]Dorok[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，清除效果，造成钝击伤害并发动额外攻击[/color]

Tengri.title: Tengri
Tengri.name: [color=#60ffb0]Tengri[/color]
Tengri.brief: 切风之神。居于东方沙漠的开阔天空。奖赏敏捷与冒险
Tengri.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，清除冻结/缠绕/疾病，并造成区域斩击伤害
Tengri.prayer:
O [color=#cf6f40]Dorok[/color],

unmoving visage,

you do not listen,

I do not care,

strengthen me,

if you wish...
Tengri.description:
你信奉 [color=#60ffb0]Tengri[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，清除冻结/缠绕/疾病，并造成区域斩击伤害[/color]

Azhdaha.name: [color=#ff5000]Azhdaha[/color]
Azhdaha.brief: 龙形转化的石之女神，其躯体深埋于山地神庙领土。以可怖的龙形祝福信徒
Azhdaha.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，造成区域伤害并提高龙形层数
Azhdaha.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Azhdaha.description:
你信奉 [color=#ff5000]Azhdaha[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，造成区域伤害并提高龙形层数[/color]

Formus.title: Formus
Formus.name: [color=#ffa0f0]Formus[/color]
Formus.brief: 宇宙蚁丘之神，其子嗣仍居于星界黑暗中逐渐衰退的隧道。奖赏召唤并与神圣蚁群并肩作战者
Formus.description_start: 祈祷召唤大量蚂蚁并强化你的召唤物
Formus.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Formus.description:

[color=#707070]祈祷召唤大量蚂蚁并强化你的召唤物[/color]

Eris.title: Eris
Eris.name: [color=#fff0a0]Eris[/color]
Eris.brief: 斗争女神。Dumuzi 成神前曾信奉的神圣战士之神。奖赏个体力量
Eris.description_start: 向 Eris 祈祷不会给予任何东西……
Eris.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Eris.description:
你信奉 [color=#fff0a0]Eris[/color]。

[color=#707070]向 Eris 祈祷不会给予任何东西……[/color]

Oros.title: Oros
Oros.name: [color=#8040a0]Oros[/color]
Oros.brief: 吞噬之夜的怪物女神。“噬星者”的手足，许久以前被打落至 Achra。奖赏穿戴其腐败遗物者
Oros.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗并召唤触须
Oros.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Oros.description:
你信奉 [color=#8040a0]Oros[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗并召唤触须[/color]

Pallas.name: [color=#ff7070]Pallas[/color]
Pallas.brief: 防御与机巧女神。曾是失落 Shuppurak 的神圣守护者。奖赏副手战斗与格挡
Pallas.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，造成穿刺伤害并升级你的副手武器
Pallas.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Pallas.description:
你信奉 [color=#ff7070]Pallas[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，造成穿刺伤害并升级你的副手武器[/color]

Fawdaa.name: [color=#90ff60]Fawdaa[/color]
Fawdaa.brief: 混沌与离体之神。可怖 Umbraliths 被轻蔑的父亲。奖赏持续传送
Fawdaa.description_start: 祈祷会随机传送自身、盟友与敌人
Fawdaa.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!

[color=#707070]祈祷会随机传送自身、盟友与敌人[/color]

Mardok.title: Mardok
Mardok.name: [color=#ff8030]Mardok[/color]
Mardok.brief: 失落兽之石城的神。以沉重带角的“马尔多克头盔”祝福信徒
Mardok.description_start: 祈祷强化盟友并召唤马尔多克之兽
Mardok.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Mardok.description:
你信奉 [color=#ff8030]Mardok[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷强化盟友并召唤马尔多克之兽[/color]

Yu.title: Yu
Yu.name: [color=#50f080]Yu[/color]
Yu.brief: 失落 Shuppurak 的“毒石”；被禁的玉石女神。奖赏迟缓
Yu.description_start: 祈祷施加折射，重新施加你的效果，并造成毒素伤害
Yu.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Yu.description:
你信奉 [color=#50f080]Yu[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷施加折射，重新施加你的效果，并造成毒素伤害[/color]

Ikshana.title: Ikshana
Ikshana.name: [color=#0070ff]Ikshana[/color]
Ikshana.brief: 曾立于星之路尽头的神圣之眼。如今封存在微光石中。召唤三种神圣色相的魔化 Prisma
Ikshana.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Ikshana.description:
你信奉 [color=#0070ff]Ikshana[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷召唤各种 Prisma[/color]

Phoenix.title: Phoenix
Phoenix.name: [color=#ff9000]Phoenix[/color]
Phoenix.brief: 失落太阳女神。Achra 已消逝的“第一道光”。允许信徒在荣耀火焰中重生
Phoenix.description_start: 祈祷施加致盲、灼烧，并提高造成的伤害
Phoenix.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Phoenix.description:
你信奉 [color=#ff9000]Phoenix[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷施加致盲、灼烧，并提高造成的伤害[/color]

Dudar.title: Dudar
Dudar.name: [color=#ffd000]蠕虫[/color]
Dudar.brief: 永恒蠕虫，沉睡于众神沙漠之下。通过 Du' Eird 心智献祭仪式提供强大的灵能腐蚀光环
Dudar.description_start: 祈祷对自身施加腐蚀，并对敌人造成灵能伤害
Dudar.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Dudar.description:
你信奉 [color=#ffd000]蠕虫[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷对自身施加腐蚀，并对敌人造成灵能伤害[/color]

Agara.name: [color=#ff50ff]Agara[/color]
Agara.brief: 术士之神；四灾之主。神圣手足 Ragna、Auzom、Sita 与 Rabal 的族长。以毁灭魔法强化信徒
Agara.description_start: 祈祷在区域内造成星界、闪电、火焰和寒冰伤害
Agara.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Agara.description:
你信奉 [color=#ff50ff]Agara[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷在区域内造成星界、闪电、火焰和寒冰伤害[/color]

Takhal.title: Takhal
Takhal.name: [color=#80af00]Takhal[/color]
Takhal.brief: 瘟疫之神，其面容是一座暗石宝坛，隐藏在东方沙漠。被称为“随风而行的影子”，是 Tengri 永恒的敌人，据说能赐予悲惨的活力
Takhal.description_start: 祈祷提供治疗，提高最大生命，并对自身造成死亡/毒素伤害
Takhal.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Takhal.description:
你信奉 [color=#80af00]Takhal[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷提供治疗，提高最大生命，并对自身造成死亡/毒素伤害[/color]

Angra.name: [color=#90ff20]Angra[/color]
Angra.brief: 来自地下的“无法之兽”；掌管饥饿、无名裂隙与畸怪。憎恶星辰，要求献上追随者之血，寻求大地的神圣剧变
Angra.description_start: 祈祷造成毒素/鲜血伤害，提供治疗并施加疾病/流血
Angra.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Angra.description:
你信奉 [color=#90ff20]Angra[/color]。

[color=#707070]祈祷造成毒素/鲜血伤害，提供治疗并施加疾病/流血[/color]

Apophis.title: Apophis
Apophis.name: [color=#700090]Apophis[/color]
Apophis.brief: 外暗中的长蛇，光明之外的尘埃虚空。Apophis 是 Phoenix 的古老敌人。信奉者以自身毁灭换取非自然且不断增长的力量
Apophis.description_start: 祈祷造成星界伤害，并移除自身有害效果
Apophis.prayer:
O [color=#ff8000]Hadad[/color],

father of lightning,

of the twice-burned hand,

your destroying spirit,

your obliterating gaze,

honor me!
Apophis.description:
